reconciliation.ifPreferredNumberExistsAndMatches: reconcile only the declared fields and options
reconciliation.ifPreferredNumberAbsent: create exactly one organization Project titled KBP ADU Product Program, link only the declared repository, record its number and URL
reconciliation.ifPreferredNumberUnrelatedAmbiguousOrIna: stop BLOCKED — PROJECT TARGET OR AUTHORIZATION; do not create a duplicate

authority.statement: This Project is a derived dispatch and control view. No Project field value constitutes Owner acceptance, engineering approval, certification, or merge authority. When a Project field and the underlying evidence disagree, the evidence wins and the divergence is reported, not silently resolved.

fields.name: Workflow State
fields.derivedFrom: the single state: label on the Issue

fields.name: Gate
fields.derivedFrom: the single gate: label on the Issue

fields.name: Worker
fields.derivedFrom: the single worker: label on the Issue

fields.name: Mode
fields.derivedFrom: the single mode: label on the Issue

fields.name: Domain
fields.contentRule: the exact primary domain label, for example domain:github-control-plane
fields.derivedFrom: the single domain: label on the Issue

fields.name: Head SHA
fields.contentRule: full 40-character lowercase hexadecimal commit SHA, or blank before RESULT
fields.derivedFrom: the exact head published in RESULT

fields.name: Evidence URL
fields.contentRule: one durable Issue, pull request, check run, or workflow run URL
fields.derivedFrom: the durable artifact that proves the current state

fields.name: Owner Decision
fields.note: Accepted records that an Owner decision exists and points to it. It is an index of that comment, never a substitute for it, and no session may set it on the Owner's behalf.

itemPolicy.addedItems: Issues governed by this control plane
prohibited: deleting, renaming, archiving, or closing historical Issues or pull requests
setting Owner Decision without a persisted Owner comment
any Project field mutation performed by a GitHub Action
